firstPlayerRule: Nobody goes first: after “Ready, set, go!” everyone swaps cards with the center at the same time, without turns.

sources.title: Kemps — How to Play
sources.publisher: Bicycle Cards (The United States Playing Card Company)

internalEvidence: Read the Bicycle Cards Kemps page in a browser. "Say, ‘Ready, set, go!’ and begin the round. Each player can discard a card from their hand and then grab any card from the center of the table. It is an ongoing process without structured turns".
